## Comparision of Carbon metabolic genes in irrigated and non-irrigated fields

# Load packages

```{r}
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
```

# Obtain the abundance of genes related to different caron sources

```{r}
design <- read.csv("./Data/Metadata.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
abund.raw <- read.csv("./Data/RPKM.KO.abundance_9353.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
abund.raw <- abund.raw[,rownames(design)]

# Retrieve carbon metabolic genes according to their functional information in KEGG database, 
# and then compare the relative abundance in irrigated and non-irrigate fields

# Starch metabolic genes
spec <- read.csv("./Data/Starch_genes_reference.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
gene <- abund.raw[rownames(abund.raw) %in% spec[,"KO"],]
gene.sum <- apply(gene, 2, sum)
gene2 <- data.frame(design, gene.sum)
wilcox.test(gene.sum ~ Irrigation, paired = F, data = gene2) # W = 608, p-value = 0.6746
# Mean value
tapply(gene2$gene.sum, gene2$Irrigation, mean)
log2((2251-2254)/2251 + 1)  # -0.002


# Hemicellulose metabolic genes
spec <- read.csv("./Data/Hemicellulose_genes_referenc.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
gene <- abund.raw[rownames(abund.raw) %in% spec[,"KO"],]
gene.sum <- apply(gene, 2, sum)
gene2 <- data.frame(design, gene.sum)
wilcox.test(gene.sum ~ Irrigation, paired = F, data = gene2) # W = 759, p-value = 0.02741
# Mean value
tapply(gene2$gene.sum, gene2$Irrigation, mean)
log2((646-572)/646 + 1)  # 0.156


# Cellulose metabolic genes

log2((1293-1237)/1293 + 1)  # 0.061
```

## Plot the abundance of carbon substrate degradation genes

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

my_cols <- c(
  "Starch" = "#C63300",
  "Hemicellulose" = "#FF7744",
  "Cellulose" = "#FFAA33",
  "Chitin" = "#EEEE00",
  "Pectin" = "#BBFF66",
  "Aromatics" = "#00AA55",
  "Lignin" = "#377eb8",
  "C.fixation" = "#DDA0DD",
  "Methane" = "#AFEEEE"
)

# The FoldChange values calculated above
dx <- data.frame(substrate = c("Starch","Hemicellulose","Cellulose","Chitin","Pectin","Aromatics","Lignin",
                               "C.fixation","Methane"),
                 log2FoldChange = c(-0.002, 0.156, 0.061, 0.126, 0.172, 0.021, -0.025, 0.0052, -0.055))
  
dx$substrate <- factor(dx$substrate, levels = c("Starch","Hemicellulose","Cellulose",
                                              "Chitin","Pectin","Aromatics","Lignin","C.fixation","Methane"))
theme_set(theme_bw())
p <- ggplot(dx, aes(x= substrate, y= log2FoldChange)) + 
  geom_bar(aes(fill = substrate), stat = "identity", color= "black") + xlab("") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_cols) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black", angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  ylim(-0.055, 0.21)

p
ggsave("./Output/Carbon_degradation_genes.pdf", p, width = 6.3, height = 4.7)
```


# Transform gene counts into relative abundance and export for subsequent analysis

```{r}
design <- read.csv("./Data/Metadata.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
abund.raw <- read.csv("./Data/RPKM.KO.abundance_9353.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
abund.raw <- abund.raw[,rownames(design)]

# Transform into relative abundance within each sample
rel_abundance <- prop.table(as.matrix(abund.raw), margin = 2)

# percent
rel_abundance_perc <- rel_abundance * 100
print(rel_abundance_perc)

write.csv(rel_abundance_perc, file = "./Output/Relative_abundance_percent_KO_count.csv")



# ============================================================
# Calculate mean relative abundance by Irrigation
# ============================================================

# 1. Ensure sample order matches metadata
design.new <- design[
  colnames(rel_abundance_perc),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(rel_abundance_perc),
    rownames(design.new)
  )
)

# 2. Identify samples in each group
irr_samples <- rownames(design.new)[
  design.new$Irrigation == "irrigated"
]

nonirr_samples <- rownames(design.new)[
  design.new$Irrigation == "non-irrigated"
]

# 3. Calculate mean relative abundance (%) for each KO
mean_abundance <- data.frame(
  KO = rownames(rel_abundance_perc),

  mean.irr = rowMeans(
    rel_abundance_perc[, irr_samples, drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  mean.nonirr = rowMeans(
    rel_abundance_perc[, nonirr_samples, drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  check.names = FALSE
)

# 4. Calculate difference and log2 fold change
mean_abundance$Difference <- (mean_abundance$mean.irr - mean_abundance$mean.nonirr) / mean_abundance$mean.nonirr

# 5. View results
head(mean_abundance)

# 6. Export results
write.csv(mean_abundance, "./Output/KO_mean_relative_abundance_by_Irrigation_All.genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Match the mean abundance table with the gene annotation.

```{r}
kegg <- read.csv("./Data/RPKM.KO.annotation_9353.csv", 
                 header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

kegg_sub <- kegg[kegg$KO %in% rownames(mean_abundance), ]
rownames(kegg_sub) <- kegg_sub[,1]
kegg_sub <- kegg_sub[,-1]

mean_abundance01 <- kegg_sub %>%  left_join(mean_abundance, by = "KO")
write.csv(mean_abundance01, "./Output/KO_mean_relative_abundance_by_Irrigation.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
